title: Chronix
subtitle: Countdown & event timer for Android — track the days to the moments that matter, right from your home screen, with calendar import, reminders and backup.

sections.description: Chronix turns important dates — birthdays, deadlines, holidays, trips — into live countdowns you can glance at any time. Add events by hand or import them straight from your device calendar, pin them to your home screen as widgets, and get a reminder before they arrive. Everything is stored locally on your device.
features: Create countdowns for any date and watch the days tick down
Import events directly from your device calendar (read-only)
Home-screen widgets in 2×2, 4×2, 4×4 and timer sizes
Reminders and milestone notifications, re-scheduled after reboot
Back up and restore your countdowns, and share them as a card
Editorial "Ink" design with light & dark themes and 7 languages
Your countdowns are stored locally on your device

sections.description: Chronix is engineered on Clean Architecture with a fully modularized, feature-based structure. Build logic is centralized through Gradle Convention Plugins and a Version Catalog, keeping every module consistent and duplication-free. Navigation uses the type-safe Navigation3 library through a custom NavigationManager.
features: Data / Domain / Presentation separation per feature module
Hilt dependency injection with scoped components
Type-safe Navigation3 with a custom NavigationManager
Convention Plugins & Version Catalog for build logic
Unit and screenshot (golden) tests with JUnit, MockK, Turbine and Roborazzi; Detekt static analysis
